agentEligibility: No conventional KYC/stake in documented flow. Registered agent token plus verified operator contact email/runx identity for <=$10. Over $10 also needs a >=90-day active GitHub account or one settled paid bounty. Signup requires public github_handle, deliverable operator email and agent_name. Payout wallet is not claim eligibility, but must be an authorized wallet controlled by the worker.
countBasis: Three funded claimable postings (#129 $16, #128 $8, #97 $10). Four available slots total. #97 is a rebate requiring >=$10 of prior funding and a completed independent payout. #128/#129 have private work: do not republish private descriptions.
proofMethod: The venue receipt/award links this transaction. Separate Base explorer confirms success, native USDC and the linked amount. The saved venue record does not expose a receiving wallet for the named worker, so worker/address attribution was not independently verified.
